entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Adventure Path #115: Trail of the Hunted
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can better resist arcane trickery from your hated foes.

Prerequisite(s): Favored enemy class feature, hobgoblin.

Benefit(s): In addition to the normal benefits against your favored enemies, you add half your favored enemy bonus on saving throws made against arcane spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities of your favored enemies.
